name: corner
description: Independent nutrition and training planning, organized as a Turborepo.

scripts.build:workers: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter server exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker && pnpm --filter server exec wrangler deploy --config ../web/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/worker && pnpm --filter server exec wrangler deploy --env preview --dry-run --outdir dist/worker-preview
scripts.build:web:worker: pnpm run build --filter=web && pnpm --filter server exec wrangler deploy --config ../web/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/worker
scripts.build:server:preview: pnpm run build --filter=server --filter=web && pnpm --filter server exec wrangler deploy --env preview --dry-run --outdir dist/worker-preview
scripts.deploy:server:preview: pnpm --filter server exec wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.smoke:workers: node scripts/workers-smoke.mjs --frontend-config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/workers-smoke.mjs --frontend-preview-config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
